name: DeepCache
plain: On most steps it runs only the shallow UNet blocks and reuses the deep decoder feature from the last full step. Interval-based, with no change metric at all. The wrapper reimplements the UNet forward, so it can miss hooks added to core since.
math:
If current_step%interval≠0, in window: run input blocks up to cache_depth, skip middle, skip early output blocks, h = cache_h at output index N−depth−1, then finish shallow outputs.
Full step: run all and cache_h = h at that index.

props.architectures: UNet only (input_blocks, middle_block, output_blocks). SAX_Bridge has a structure guard.

providers.author: SoftMeng
providers.note: Adds input_cache and middle_cache options; default interval 3, window 0-12

providers.note: Percent start, UNet guard; not read fully
